nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in the Owned constructor and checked in the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership / acceptOwnership).
Public token symbol string ('ESPRO') set in the constructor.
Public token name string ('EsportsPro') set in the constructor.
Public token decimals (18) set in the constructor.
Internal total token supply, mutated by Burn and Mint and read by totalSupply().
Allocation of tokens for sales, assigned to sales_account in the constructor.
Allocation of tokens for the company reserve, assigned to company_reserve in the constructor.
Declared reserve bucket for the user base; written only in the constructor.
Declared reserve bucket for airdrops; never assigned or used.
Public address holding the token sales allocation.
Public address holding the company reserve allocation.
Public unlock timestamp that is declared but never written or enforced.
Creation timestamp set from block.timestamp (now) in the constructor.
Core accounting mapping of address to token balance.
Nested allowance mapping used by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
EsportsPro constructor that sets metadata, supply allocations, createdAt = now, and initial balances.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer when msg.sender equals newOwner.
View function returning _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public token transfer that debits msg.sender and credits the recipient using SafeMath.
onlyOwner function reducing a target balance and the total supply.
onlyOwner function increasing a target balance and the total supply.
Public function setting allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens.
Public function moving tokens on behalf of 'from' after debiting the caller allowance.
View function returning the remaining allowance for a spender.
Public function that approves a spender and then calls receiveApproval on that spender contract.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts on any plain ETH transfer.
onlyOwner rescue function invoking transfer on an arbitrary external ERC20 token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, balance ownership and allowance bookkeeping.
Block timestamp (now) used in the constructor to set createdAt.
Original transaction sender; recognized as an untrusted input though not referenced in this code.
External call to an arbitrary spender contract via ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval.
External call to an owner-supplied token contract address through ERC20Interface.transfer.
SafeMath add/sub operations mutating balances and _totalSupply in transfer, Burn, Mint and transferFrom.
Parameter of transferOwnership naming the staged new owner.
Parameter of Burn giving the account whose balance is reduced.
Parameter of Burn giving the amount of tokens to destroy.
Parameter of transferAnyERC20Token naming the external token contract to call.
Parameter of transferAnyERC20Token giving the amount of external tokens to move.
Parameter of approveAndCall giving the spender contract that will be called back.
Parameter of approveAndCall giving the approved amount forwarded to the callback.
Parameter of approveAndCall carrying arbitrary calldata into the external receiveApproval call.
Local result variable of the SafeMath add/sub helpers used by the balance arithmetic.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance written by approve.
msg.sender is approved and forwarded in the receiveApproval callback.
acceptOwnership authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to newOwner.
onlyOwner gate in transferOwnership compares msg.sender to owner.
Burn is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Mint is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Block timestamp (now) determines createdAt at construction time.
owner state variable is the reference checked by onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership reads owner for the event and writes the new owner value.
newOwner is compared and cleared inside acceptOwnership.
newOwner is assigned inside transferOwnership.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
Burn mutates balances for the requested address.
Mint mutates balances for the requested address.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for from and to.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns the allowed mapping entry.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
Burn decreases _totalSupply.
Mint increases _totalSupply.
transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on balance values.
Burn performs SafeMath sub on balance and total supply.
Mint performs SafeMath add on balance and total supply.
transferFrom performs SafeMath sub/add on balances and allowance.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a caller-supplied spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary external token contract.
Constructor initializes balances for sales_account and company_reserve.
Constructor sets _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns createdAt.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner.
_address parameter selects the balance debited by Burn.
value parameter is the amount removed by Burn.
tokenAddress parameter becomes the external contract target.
tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external transfer.
spender parameter is both approved and called back.
tokens parameter sets the allowance and callback amount.
data parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
Local SafeMath result feeds the balance and supply updates.

normalization_plan.reason: The new-owner argument only exists to populate the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
The targeted account parameter is only meaningful inside the Burn function body.
The burn amount parameter is only consumed by the Burn arithmetic.
The external token address parameter is only used to build the ERC20Interface call.
The amount parameter is only forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
The spender parameter is only used for the allowance write and the callback target.
The token amount parameter is only used in approveAndCall state and callback data.
The data blob parameter is only forwarded from approveAndCall into the external call.
The SafeMath result local variable is only a temporary for the balance arithmetic operation.
